name: relaxed_hand
doc: Natural relaxed hand for arms-at-sides poses. Angles in degrees, per bone <Side>Hand<Finger><1..3> (Index/Middle/Ring/Pinky: 1=knuckle(MCP), 2=middle(PIP), 3=tip(DIP); Thumb: 1=CMC, 2=MCP, 3=IP). flex = curl toward the palm (progressive from index to pinky, each finger's 3 joints form a soft arc). spread = fan away from the middle finger (applied at the knuckle). thumb.adduct = swing of the thumb base toward the index finger. Applied identically (mirrored automatically from each hand's rest geometry) to Left/Right. Works on any rig with Ariel-style hand bone names whose REST pose has the palms facing restPalmDir (character-space axes: x=left, y=up, z=forward).

weight.note: blend weight 1 when the wrist is lower than (hips height + start), fading to 0 at (hips height + end) in metres of character space; grabbing/climbing clips are excluded by name
